verdict.rationale: Claude offers a developer API (claude-docs-2), so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an OpenAPI or equivalent spec: the probe got 404 on every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on support.claude.com. The llms.txt help-center index is a documentation listing, not an API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
